# Trading Direkt 2026-11-10 | AuAg´s Eric Strand om ädelmetaller, Tobbe med TA

**Feed**: trading-direkt  
**Published**: 2026-11-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

AuAg Fonder's Eric Strand is very bullish on precious metals despite the eight-month correction. He argues that cost-push inflation, money printing and central bank buying will push gold toward 10,000 and silver to 200-300, and he prefers mining stocks over the metals themselves. Tobbe Rosén's technical analysis sees the sharp drop last Thursday as an overreaction and a seasonal autumn/winter rally as likely starting. In viewer requests he is positive on Microsoft, Adidas, Attendo, Ericsson and Bure but negative on Nvidia, which fell on news of an investigation into its CEO.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 MSFT — Microsoft | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Weekly MA200 and medium-term MAs rising; any pullback seen as buyable; 'mycket positiv'.

#### Reasoning

Host TA analyst Tobbe Rosén: long and medium moving averages point up and the trend is strong medium term. Volatility has contracted from high levels, so a pullback may come, but he expects it to be buyable. The earlier pullback briefly broke Fib 38 but the level has been reclaimed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks below Fib 38 again and fails to reclaim it
- if the medium-term MAs turn down

> *"sikt så är jag mycket positiv till Microsoft"*

---

### 🟢 ATT — Attendo | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Rose 16% on report; expects a pullback due to overbought stochastics, which he says will be buyable.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe: strong report gaps often pull back, which he sees as healthy. Stochastics are above 80 and the cycle indicator signals an 'exhale', but he expects the 'second chance' pullback toward support to offer good upside edge.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the pullback breaks below the report-day support levels

> *"Den rekylen tror jag däremot kommer bli köpvärdig i Attendo."*

---

### 🟢 ADS — Adidas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Positive, expects continued rise; possible new higher bottom in range, but overbought near the top.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe: the stock is in a range with a possible higher low, confirmed if ~190 EUR is passed. Stochastics and a negative %B divergence at the upper Bollinger band mean there is a risk of reversal at the top, but he believes in a continued rise.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price reverses at the range top and breaks support levels
- if 190 EUR is not passed

> *"Men jag är positiv till Adidas och tror på fortsatt uppgång."*

---

### 🟢 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Ichimoku positive: price above the cloud and the cloud turning up; looks to be gearing up for a rise.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe, at a viewer's request, reads Ichimoku: the cloud is now ticking upward and price sits above it, both positive signs. The thesis changes if price breaks down and establishes itself below the cloud.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks down and establishes below the Ichimoku cloud
- if the lagging line falls below price/cloud

> *"det ser faktiskt ut som att Ericsson laddar upp inför en uppgång enligt det vi ser i Ichimoku"*

---

### 🟠 BURE — Bure | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Choppy consolidation after report; MA100/MA200 rising with price above; watch for a stochastic MACD turn up.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe: after an initial positive report reaction the price fell back and is consolidating around the short and medium MAs. Long MAs point up with price above, so a break up from the tight consolidation, signalled by stochastic MACD turning up, often gives strong moves.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks below MA100/MA200
- if consolidation resolves downward

> *"Så jätteintressant att bevaka Bure."*

---

### ⛔ NVDA — Nvidia | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Oversold at support after the CEO probe; Tobbe negative until price breaks the standard line with higher tops.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe says Nvidia is heavily oversold near support and the move might be an overreaction unless the scandal damaged the company. He stays negative until price breaks above the standard line and makes new higher short-term tops. Market update: the board and FBI are investigating CEO Jensen Huang over alleged Chinese espionage links.

#### Sell Triggers

- turn positive if price breaks above the standard line and sets higher short-term tops

> *"Men jag är negativ till Nvidia så som det ser ut just nu."*

---

### 🟠 AZN — AstraZeneca | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Tough resistance overhead with high vol and an overbought state means a big risk of reversal; a rounded bottom offers potential on a breakout.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe: big risk of a counter-reaction at resistance while overbought with high volatility. A later attempt with higher bottoms and low vol on a breakout would give good upside potential from the rounded-bottom pattern.

#### Sell Triggers

- if short-term momentum turns down from high levels at resistance

> *"det är väldigt väldigt stor risk med tanke på den här höga vållan. Det överköpta läget för att AstraZeneca ska vända ner"*

---

### 🟡 NCC-B — NCC | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Positive report reaction, testing MA200; neutral for now.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe notes a positive report reaction and price trying to break above the 200-day moving average, but he takes a neutral stance for now.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price fails at MA200 and falls back

> *"Jag är neutral för tillfället till NCC så som det ser ut just nu."*

---

### 🟠 UAA — Under Armour | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Possible confirmed inverted head-and-shoulders with limited target to MA200; stochastic MACD above zero; still weakly negative overall.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe sees an inverted head-and-shoulders that looks weakly positive with stochastic MACD above zero. The measured move may only reach MA200, so he stays weakly negative overall.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price fails below MA200 and the pattern breaks down

> *"Jag är dock. Än så länge svagt negativ till Underarm."*

---

### 🟠 NKE — Nike | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Short-term rising trend above MA20/50, but longer term mostly down; Ichimoku hints at perking up.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe: short-term positive structure above the standard line and short MAs, but the longer-term trend points down and the lagging line is not yet above the cloud.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks below MA20/MA50

> *"Men på längre sikt så pekar det mesta neråt så som vi ser."*
